purpose: Compliant staged publication strategy for building real GitHub Marketplace App installations through a genuine free Marketplace offering before converting the existing listing to paid plans after current paid-listing requirements are met.

phase_1_free_listing.goal: Publish a genuinely useful free Marketplace listing that meets all general listing requirements and accumulate real installations/operating evidence without pretending paid eligibility exists.

free_plan_definition.rule: Do not invent a Community/free entitlement set merely to collect installations. Define real user value and explicit free entitlements before publication, validate them against runtime authorization, and keep paid Developer/Pro/Team/Enterprise drafts unchanged until separately approved.

phase_1_free_listing.outside_marketplace_paid_service_conside: If a paid version is offered outside GitHub Marketplace while the Marketplace listing is free, re-check GitHub's current free-app rules; the 2026-09-04 source states that after the listing meets paid-app requirements, at least one paid plan must be offered in GitHub Marketplace.

conversion.rule: This strategy may recommend when to apply for paid publication, but it cannot change Marketplace pricing, publish paid plans, activate premium entitlements, or claim GitHub approval.

safety: Never create artificial, purchased, duplicate, deceptive, or otherwise non-genuine installations to satisfy an eligibility threshold.
Do not publish a free app whose only purpose is authentication or installation counting; it must provide real GitHub-integrated user value.
Do not collapse the public Marketplace App and private Vendor Distribution App trust roles or reuse their private keys.
Do not grant private_template_access or other paid/premium entitlements to a free Marketplace plan unless the operator deliberately approves that product decision and runtime tests enforce it.
Do not represent a free Marketplace listing as evidence that paid Marketplace requirements have been met.
Re-check official GitHub documentation immediately before free listing submission and again before paid conversion.
